name: hotspot-analysis
description: Rank Java source files and methods by a Composite Hotspot Score that combines recency-weighted git revisions, cognitive complexity, and JaCoCo coverage gap — so testing and refactoring effort lands where the historical evidence says bugs are most likely to live. Based on Adam Tornhill's 'Your Code as a Crime Scene'. Bundles a skill that drives the project's Java CLI (build → init config → analyze → interpret CSV/YAML/Markdown/HTML reports).
